L99-N-LINE07.text: 对不起，露西。恐怕我站不起来。

L99-N-LINE08.text: 我想最好让医生看看你，我给卡特医生打电话。

L99-N-LINE09.text: 医生说他马上来。安迪，我想你需要拍张 X 光片。

L101-D01.text: Read Jimmy's card to me please, Penny.
L101-D01.translation: 彭妮，请把吉米的明信片读给我听。
L101-D01.speaker: woman

L101-D02.text: 'I have just arrived in Scotland and I'm staying at a Youth Hostel.'
L101-D02.translation: “我刚到苏格兰，住在一家青年旅舍。”
L101-D02.speaker: woman

L101-D04.text: He says he's just arrived in Scotland. He says he's staying at a Youth Hostel.
L101-D04.translation: 他说他刚到苏格兰，住在一家青年旅舍。
L101-D04.speaker: woman

L101-D05.text: You know he's a member of the Y.H.A.
L101-D05.translation: 您知道，他是青年旅舍协会的会员。
L101-D05.speaker: woman

L101-D07.text: The Y.H.A., Mum. The Youth Hostels Association.
L101-D07.speaker: woman

L101-D09.text: 'I'll write a letter soon. I hope you are all well.'
L101-D09.translation: “我很快会写信，希望你们都好。”
L101-D09.speaker: woman

L101-D10.text: What? Speak up, Penny. I'm afraid I can't hear you.
L101-D10.translation: 什么？彭妮，大声点，恐怕我听不见。
L101-D10.speaker: woman

L101-D11.text: He says he'll write a letter soon. He hopes we are all well. 'Love, Jimmy.'
L101-D11.translation: 他说很快会写信，希望我们都好。“爱你们的，吉米。”
L101-D11.speaker: woman

L101-D12.text: Is that all? He doesn't say very much, does he?
L101-D12.translation: 就这些吗？他说得不多，对吧？
L101-D12.speaker: woman

L101-D13.text: He can't write very much on a card, Mum.
L101-D13.translation: 妈妈，明信片上写不了太多。
L101-D13.speaker: woman

L101-N-GRAMMAR.text: 转述 He says ... 时，按说话者调整 I → he、we/you 等人称，that 常可省略。主句是现在时 says 时，不必机械把从句改成过去时。

L101-E01.text: He says he has just arrived.

L101-E02.text: She says she is staying at a hostel.

L101-E03.text: He says he will write soon.

L101-E05.text: She says she has shut the door.

L101-E06.text: He hopes we are all well.

L101-N-LINE01.text: 彭妮，请把吉米的明信片读给我听。

L101-N-LINE02.text: “我刚到苏格兰，住在一家青年旅舍。”

L101-N-LINE04.text: 他说他刚到苏格兰，住在一家青年旅舍。

L101-N-LINE05.text: 您知道，他是青年旅舍协会的会员。

L101-N-LINE09.text: “我很快会写信，希望你们都好。”

L101-N-LINE10.text: 什么？彭妮，大声点，恐怕我听不见。

L101-N-LINE11.text: 他说很快会写信，希望我们都好。“爱你们的，吉米。”

L101-N-LINE12.text: 就这些吗？他说得不多，对吧？

L101-N-LINE13.text: 妈妈，明信片上写不了太多。

L103-D02.text: Not too bad. I think I passed in English and Mathematics.
L103-D02.translation: 还不太坏，我想英语和数学及格了。
L103-D02.speaker: man

L103-D03.text: The questions were very easy. How about you, Gary?
L103-D03.speaker: man

L103-D04.text: The English and Maths papers weren't easy enough for me. I hope I haven't failed.
L103-D04.translation: 英语和数学卷对我来说不够容易，希望我没有不及格。
L103-D04.speaker: man

L103-D05.text: I think I failed the French paper.
L103-D05.translation: 我想我的法语卷不及格。
L103-D05.speaker: man

L103-D06.text: I could answer sixteen of the questions. They were very easy.
L103-D06.translation: 我能答出十六道题，那些题很容易。
L103-D06.speaker: man

L103-D07.text: But I couldn't answer the rest. They were too difficult for me.
L103-D07.translation: 但其余的我答不出来，对我来说太难了。
L103-D07.speaker: man

L103-D08.text: French tests are awful, aren't they?
L103-D08.translation: 法语考试很糟糕，是不是？
L103-D08.speaker: man

L103-D09.text: I hate them. I'm sure I've got a low mark.
L103-D09.translation: 我讨厌它们，我肯定分数很低。
L103-D09.speaker: man

L103-D10.text: Oh, cheer up! Perhaps we didn't do too badly.
L103-D10.translation: 噢，振作点！也许我们考得没有那么糟。
L103-D10.speaker: man

L103-D11.text: The guy next to me wrote his name at the top of the paper.
L103-D11.translation: 坐在我旁边的人把名字写在试卷顶端。
L103-D11.speaker: man

L103-D13.text: Then he sat there and looked at it for three hours! He didn't write a word!
L103-D13.translation: 然后他坐在那里看了整整三个小时，一个字也没写！
L103-D13.speaker: man

L103-N-GRAMMAR.text: too + 形容词 + to do 表示太……以至不能；形容词 + enough + to do 表示足够……可以。very 只是程度很。could/couldn’t 表示过去能否做到。

L103-E01.text: The bag is too heavy for me to carry.

L103-E02.text: The question is easy enough for me to answer.
L103-E02.translation: 这道题足够容易，我能答。

L103-E04.text: The box is light enough to carry.
L103-E04.translation: 这个箱子够轻，可以提动。

L103-E05.text: The music was too low for us to hear.
L103-E05.translation: 音乐声太低，我们听不见。

L103-E06.text: She could not answer the rest.

L103-N-LINE02.text: 还不太坏，我想英语和数学及格了。

L103-N-LINE04.text: 英语和数学卷对我来说不够容易，希望我没有不及格。

L103-N-LINE05.text: 我想我的法语卷不及格。

L103-N-LINE06.text: 我能答出十六道题，那些题很容易。

L103-N-LINE07.text: 但其余的我答不出来，对我来说太难了。

L103-N-LINE08.text: 法语考试很糟糕，是不是？

L103-N-LINE09.text: 我讨厌它们，我肯定分数很低。

L103-N-LINE10.text: 噢，振作点！也许我们考得没有那么糟。

L103-N-LINE11.text: 坐在我旁边的人把名字写在试卷顶端。

L103-N-LINE13.text: 然后他坐在那里看了整整三个小时，一个字也没写！

L105-D01.text: Where's Sandra, Bob? I want her.
L105-D01.translation: 鲍勃，桑德拉在哪里？我找她。
L105-D01.speaker: man

L105-D02.text: Do you want to speak to her?
L105-D02.speaker: man

L105-D03.text: Yes, I do. I want her to come to my office. Tell her to come at once.
L105-D03.translation: 是的，让她到我办公室来。告诉她马上来。
L105-D03.speaker: man

L105-D04.text: Did you want to see me?
L105-D04.speaker: woman

L105-D05.text: Ah, yes, Sandra. How do you spell 'intelligent'? Can you tell me?
L105-D05.translation: 是的，桑德拉。intelligent 怎么拼？你能告诉我吗？
L105-D05.speaker: man

L105-D07.text: That's right. You've typed it with only one 'L'.
L105-D07.translation: 对，但你打的时候只打了一个 L。
L105-D07.speaker: man

L105-D08.text: This letter's full of mistakes. I want you to type it again.
L105-D08.translation: 这封信错误很多，我要你重新打一遍。
L105-D08.speaker: man

L105-D09.text: Yes, I'll do that. I'm sorry about that.
L105-D09.translation: 好的，我会重打。对此我很抱歉。
L105-D09.speaker: woman

L105-D10.text: And here's a little present for you.
L105-D10.translation: 这里还有件小礼物给你。
L105-D10.speaker: man

L105-D12.text: It's a dictionary. I hope it'll help you.
L105-D12.translation: 是一本词典，希望能帮到你。
L105-D12.speaker: man

L105-N-GRAMMAR.text: want + 人 + to do 表示希望某人做。tell + 人 + not to do 表示告诉某人不要做，not 放在 to 前。intelligent 中间有两个 l。

L105-E01.text: I want you to correct it.

L105-E02.text: Tell her to come at once.

L105-E03.text: He is telling them not to lose it.
L105-E03.translation: 他正告诉他们不要弄丢它。

L105-E04.text: I do not want him to miss the train.

L105-E05.text: She wants me to help her.

L105-E06.text: Tell them not to break it.

L105-N-LINE01.text: 鲍勃，桑德拉在哪里？我找她。

L105-N-LINE03.text: 是的，让她到我办公室来。告诉她马上来。

L105-N-LINE05.text: 是的，桑德拉。intelligent 怎么拼？你能告诉我吗？

L105-N-LINE07.text: 对，但你打的时候只打了一个 L。

L105-N-LINE08.text: 这封信错误很多，我要你重新打一遍。

L105-N-LINE09.text: 好的，我会重打。对此我很抱歉。

L105-N-LINE10.text: 这里还有件小礼物给你。

L105-N-LINE12.text: 是一本词典，希望能帮到你。

L107-D01.text: Do you like this dress, madam?
L107-D01.translation: 女士，您喜欢这条连衣裙吗？
L107-D01.speaker: man

L107-D02.text: I like the colour very much. It's a lovely dress, but it's too small for me.
L107-D02.translation: 我很喜欢它的颜色。这条裙子很漂亮，但对我来说太小了。
L107-D02.speaker: woman

L107-D03.text: What about this one? It's a lovely dress. It's very smart.
L107-D03.translation: 这条怎么样？很漂亮，也很时髦。
L107-D03.speaker: man

L107-D04.text: Short skirts are in fashion now. Would you like to try it?
L107-D04.translation: 短裙现在很流行，您想试试吗？
L107-D04.speaker: man

L107-D06.text: I'm afraid this green dress is too small for me as well. It's smaller than the blue one.
L107-D06.translation: 恐怕这条绿色裙子对我也太小了，它比蓝色的还小。
L107-D06.speaker: woman

L107-D07.text: I don't like the colour either. It doesn't suit me at all. I think the blue dress is prettier.
L107-D07.translation: 我也不喜欢这颜色，它一点都不适合我。我觉得蓝色的更漂亮。
L107-D07.speaker: woman

L107-D08.text: Could you show me another blue dress? I want a dress like that one, but it must be my size.
L107-D08.translation: 您能再给我看一条蓝色的裙子吗？我想要那样的，但必须是我的尺码。
L107-D08.speaker: woman

L107-D09.text: I'm afraid I haven't got a larger dress. This is the largest dress in the shop.
L107-D09.translation: 恐怕没有更大的了，这是店里最大的一条。
L107-D09.speaker: man

L107-N-GRAMMAR.text: 短形容词比较级常加 -er，最高级加 -est；heavy → heavier/heaviest，hot → hotter/hottest。比较用 than，最高级前常用 the。

L107-E01.text: This dress is smaller than the blue one.
L107-E01.translation: 这条裙子比蓝色的更小。

L107-E02.text: This is the largest dress in the shop.

L107-E03.text: The blue suitcase is heavier than the brown one.
L107-E03.translation: 蓝色行李箱比棕色的更重。

L107-E05.text: This test is easier than that one.

L107-E06.text: He is the tallest student in our class.
L107-E06.translation: 他是我们班最高的学生。

L107-N-LINE01.text: 女士，您喜欢这条连衣裙吗？

L107-N-LINE02.text: 我很喜欢它的颜色。这条裙子很漂亮，但对我来说太小了。

L107-N-LINE03.text: 这条怎么样？很漂亮，也很时髦。

L107-N-LINE04.text: 短裙现在很流行，您想试试吗？

L107-N-LINE06.text: 恐怕这条绿色裙子对我也太小了，它比蓝色的还小。

L107-N-LINE07.text: 我也不喜欢这颜色，它一点都不适合我。我觉得蓝色的更漂亮。

L107-N-LINE08.text: 您能再给我看一条蓝色的裙子吗？我想要那样的，但必须是我的尺码。

L107-N-LINE09.text: 恐怕没有更大的了，这是店里最大的一条。

L109-D01.text: Shall I make some coffee, Jane?
L109-D01.speaker: woman

L109-D03.text: It's ready. Do you want any milk?
L109-D03.speaker: woman

L109-D05.text: What about some sugar? Two teaspoonfuls?
L109-D05.speaker: woman

L109-D06.text: No, less than that. One and a half teaspoonfuls, please. That's enough for me.
L109-D06.translation: 不，比那少一点。请加一茶匙半，对我就够了。
L109-D06.speaker: woman

L109-D10.text: I'd like a cigarette, too. May I have one?
L109-D10.translation: 我还想抽支烟，可以给我一支吗？
L109-D10.speaker: woman

L109-D11.text: Of course. I think there are a few in that box.
L109-D11.translation: 当然，我想那个盒子里有几支。
L109-D11.speaker: woman

L109-D15.text: Have a biscuit instead. Eat more and smoke less!
L109-D15.translation: 那吃块饼干吧。多吃一点，少抽一点！
L109-D15.speaker: woman

L109-N-GRAMMAR.text: a little/less 修饰不可数名词，a few/fewer 修饰可数复数。good → better → best；bad → worse → worst。

L109-E01.text: I have less milk than you.

L109-E02.text: She has fewer books than me.

L109-E03.text: There is a little sugar in the bowl.

L109-E04.text: There are a few biscuits in the box.

L109-E05.text: This is the best book I have read.
L109-E05.translation: 这是我读过的最好的书。

L109-E06.text: This weather is worse than yesterday's.

L109-N-LINE06.text: 不，比那少一点。请加一茶匙半，对我就够了。

L109-N-LINE10.text: 我还想抽支烟，可以给我一支吗？

L109-N-LINE11.text: 当然，我想那个盒子里有几支。

L109-N-LINE15.text: 那吃块饼干吧。多吃一点，少抽一点！

L111-D01.text: I like this television very much. How much does it cost?
L111-D01.translation: 我很喜欢这台电视，它多少钱？
L111-D01.speaker: man

L111-D02.text: It's the most expensive model in the shop. It costs five hundred pounds.
L111-D02.translation: 这是店里最贵的型号，要五百英镑。
L111-D02.speaker: man

L111-D03.text: That's too expensive for us. We can't afford all that money.
L111-D03.translation: 那对我们来说太贵了，我们负担不起那么多钱。
L111-D03.speaker: woman

L111-D04.text: This model's less expensive than that one. It's only three hundred pounds.
L111-D04.translation: 这个型号比那个便宜，只要三百英镑。
L111-D04.speaker: man

L111-D05.text: But, of course, it's not as good as the expensive one.
L111-D05.translation: 不过，当然它不如贵的那台好。
L111-D05.speaker: man

L111-D06.text: I don't like this model. The other model's more expensive, but it's worth the money.
L111-D06.translation: 我不喜欢这个型号。另一台更贵，但物有所值。
L111-D06.speaker: man

L111-D07.text: Can we buy it on instalments?
L111-D07.translation: 我们可以分期付款买吗？
L111-D07.speaker: man

L111-D08.text: Of course. You can pay a deposit of thirty pounds, and then fourteen pounds a month for three years.
L111-D08.translation: 当然。先付三十英镑定金，再每月付十四英镑，付三年。
L111-D08.speaker: man

L111-D10.text: I certainly do, but I don't like the price.
L111-D10.translation: 我当然喜欢，但不喜欢这价格。
L111-D10.speaker: woman

L111-D11.text: You always want the best, but we can't afford it. Sometimes you think you're a millionaire!
L111-D11.translation: 你总想要最好的，但我们买不起。你有时以为自己是百万富翁！
L111-D11.speaker: woman

L111-D12.text: Millionaires don't buy things on instalments!
L111-D12.translation: 百万富翁买东西可不分期付款！
L111-D12.speaker: man

L111-N-GRAMMAR.text: 较长形容词常用 more/most 或 less/least。as + 原级 + as 表示一样，not as ... as 表示不如。

L111-E01.text: This model is more expensive than that one.

L111-E02.text: This is the most difficult test I have done.
L111-E02.translation: 这是我做过的最难的测验。

L111-E03.text: The green apple is not as sweet as the red one.

L111-E04.text: This book is less interesting than yours.

L111-E05.text: It is the least expensive model.

L111-E06.text: My bag is as light as yours.

L111-N-LINE01.text: 我很喜欢这台电视，它多少钱？

L111-N-LINE02.text: 这是店里最贵的型号，要五百英镑。

L111-N-LINE03.text: 那对我们来说太贵了，我们负担不起那么多钱。

L111-N-LINE04.text: 这个型号比那个便宜，只要三百英镑。

L111-N-LINE05.text: 不过，当然它不如贵的那台好。

L111-N-LINE06.text: 我不喜欢这个型号。另一台更贵，但物有所值。

L111-N-LINE07.text: 我们可以分期付款买吗？

L111-N-LINE08.text: 当然。先付三十英镑定金，再每月付十四英镑，付三年。

L111-N-LINE10.text: 我当然喜欢，但不喜欢这价格。

L111-N-LINE11.text: 你总想要最好的，但我们买不起。你有时以为自己是百万富翁！

L111-N-LINE12.text: 百万富翁买东西可不分期付款！

L113-D03.text: I'm sorry, sir. I can't change a ten-pound note. Haven't you got any small change?
L113-D03.translation: 对不起，先生，我找不开十英镑的纸币。您没有零钱吗？
L113-D03.speaker: man

L113-D04.text: I've got no small change, I'm afraid.
L113-D04.speaker: man

L113-D05.text: I'll ask some of the passengers.
L113-D05.speaker: man

L113-D06.text: Have you any small change, sir?
L113-D06.speaker: man

L113-D09.text: Can you change this ten-pound note, madam?
L113-D09.translation: 女士，您能找开这张十英镑纸币吗？
L113-D09.speaker: man

L113-D12.text: I'm very sorry, sir. You must get off the bus. None of our passengers can change this note. They're all millionaires!
L113-D12.translation: 非常抱歉，先生，您必须下车。乘客中没人能找开这张纸币，他们都是百万富翁！
L113-D12.speaker: man

L113-N-GRAMMAR.text: no 后接名词，none 可独立使用。表示我也一样：肯定用 So + 助动词/be + I；否定用 Neither + 助动词/be + I，助动词与前句匹配。

L113-E03.text: I can swim. So can I.

L113-E04.text: I cannot swim. Neither can I.

L113-E05.text: I am tired. So am I.

L113-E06.text: I did not meet him. Neither did I.
L113-E06.translation: 我没见过他。我也没见过。

L113-N-LINE03.text: 对不起，先生，我找不开十英镑的纸币。您没有零钱吗？

L113-N-LINE09.text: 女士，您能找开这张十英镑纸币吗？

L113-N-LINE12.text: 非常抱歉，先生，您必须下车。乘客中没人能找开这张纸币，他们都是百万富翁！

L115-D02.text: I'll knock again, Helen. Everything's very quiet. I'm sure there's no one at home.
L115-D02.translation: 海伦，我再敲一次。一切很安静，我肯定家里没人。
L115-D02.speaker: man

L115-D03.text: But that's impossible. Carol and Tom invited us to lunch. Look through the window.
L115-D03.translation: 但那不可能。卡罗尔和汤姆邀请我们来吃午饭。从窗户看看。
L115-D03.speaker: woman

L115-D09.text: Everybody wants to have lunch in the garden. It's nice and warm out here.
L115-D09.translation: 大家都想在花园吃午饭，这里暖和舒服。
L115-D09.speaker: man

L115-D10.text: Come and have something to drink.
L115-D10.speaker: woman

L115-D11.text: Thanks, Carol. May I have a glass of beer please?
L115-D11.translation: 谢谢，卡罗尔。我可以喝杯啤酒吗？
L115-D11.speaker: man

L115-D12.text: Beer? There's none left. You can have some lemonade.
L115-D12.translation: 啤酒？一点都没剩下。你可以喝些柠檬水。
L115-D12.speaker: woman

L115-D14.text: Don't believe her, Jim. She's only joking. Have some beer!
L115-D14.translation: 吉姆，别信她。她只是开玩笑，喝点啤酒吧！
L115-D14.speaker: man

L115-N-GRAMMAR.text: -one/-body 指人，-thing 指事物，-where 指地点。everyone/everything 作主语通常用单数。否定句用 not ... anything，或肯定结构 + nothing，避免双重否定。

L115-E03.text: There is nothing in the box.

L115-E04.text: I looked for my pen everywhere.

L115-N-LINE02.text: 海伦，我再敲一次。一切很安静，我肯定家里没人。

L115-N-LINE03.text: 但那不可能。卡罗尔和汤姆邀请我们来吃午饭。从窗户看看。

L115-N-LINE09.text: 大家都想在花园吃午饭，这里暖和舒服。

L115-N-LINE11.text: 谢谢，卡罗尔。我可以喝杯啤酒吗？

L115-N-LINE12.text: 啤酒？一点都没剩下。你可以喝些柠檬水。

L115-N-LINE14.text: 吉姆，别信她。她只是开玩笑，喝点啤酒吧！

L117-D01.text: When my husband was going into the dining room this morning, he dropped some coins on the floor.
L117-D01.translation: 今天早上丈夫走进餐厅时，把一些硬币掉在了地上。
L117-D01.speaker: man

L117-D03.text: We looked for them, but we could not find them all.
L117-D03.translation: 我们找了，却没能全部找到。
L117-D03.speaker: man

L117-D04.text: While we were having breakfast, our little boy, Tommy, found two small coins on the floor.
L117-D04.translation: 我们吃早饭时，小儿子汤米在地上找到了两枚小硬币。
L117-D04.speaker: man

L117-D05.text: He put them both into his mouth.
L117-D05.translation: 他把两枚都放进了嘴里。
L117-D05.speaker: man

L117-D06.text: We both tried to get the coins, but it was too late.
L117-D06.translation: 我们俩都想拿出来，但已经太晚了。
L117-D06.speaker: man

L117-D07.translation: 汤米已经把它们吞了下去！
L117-D07.speaker: man

L117-D08.text: Later that morning, when I was doing the housework, my husband phoned me from the office.
L117-D08.translation: 那天上午晚些时候，我做家务时，丈夫从办公室打来电话。
L117-D08.speaker: man

L117-D10.text: 'I don't know,' I answered, 'Tommy's been to the toilet three times this morning, but I haven't had any change yet!'
L117-D10.translation: 我回答：“不知道，汤米今早已经上了三次厕所，但我还没拿到零钱呢！”
L117-D10.speaker: man

L117-N-GRAMMAR.text: was/were + -ing 交代过去正在做的背景，过去式交代中途发生的动作。while 常连接持续动作。故事用 change 的“零钱”与“变化”双关；吞硬币的动作不能模仿。

L117-E01.text: I was reading when the phone rang.

L117-E02.text: They were cooking when I arrived.

L117-E03.text: She was reading while he was cooking.

L117-E04.text: The phone rang when I was washing the dishes.

L117-E05.text: What were you doing when he arrived?

L117-E06.text: I was working in the garden yesterday afternoon.
L117-E06.translation: 昨天下午我正在花园干活。

L117-N-LINE01.text: 今天早上丈夫走进餐厅时，把一些硬币掉在了地上。

L117-N-LINE03.text: 我们找了，却没能全部找到。

L117-N-LINE04.text: 我们吃早饭时，小儿子汤米在地上找到了两枚小硬币。

L117-N-LINE05.text: 他把两枚都放进了嘴里。

L117-N-LINE06.text: 我们俩都想拿出来，但已经太晚了。

L117-N-LINE07.text: 汤米已经把它们吞了下去！

L117-N-LINE08.text: 那天上午晚些时候，我做家务时，丈夫从办公室打来电话。

L117-N-LINE10.text: 我回答：“不知道，汤米今早已经上了三次厕所，但我还没拿到零钱呢！”

L119-D01.text: Do you like stories? I want to tell you a true story.
L119-D01.translation: 你喜欢故事吗？我想给你讲个真实的故事。
L119-D01.speaker: man

L119-D02.text: It happened to a friend of mine a year ago.
L119-D02.translation: 这发生在我的一位朋友身上，是一年前的事。
L119-D02.speaker: man

L119-D03.text: While my friend, George, was reading in bed, two thieves climbed into his kitchen.
L119-D03.translation: 我朋友乔治在床上读书时，两个小偷爬进了他的厨房。
L119-D03.speaker: man

L119-D04.text: After they had entered the house, they went into the dining room.
L119-D04.translation: 他们进屋后，来到了餐厅。
L119-D04.speaker: man

L119-D05.text: It was very dark, so they turned on a torch.
L119-D05.translation: 里面很黑，所以他们打开手电筒。
L119-D05.speaker: man

L119-D06.text: Suddenly, they heard a voice behind them.
L119-D06.translation: 突然，他们听见身后有声音。
L119-D06.speaker: man

L119-D08.text: The thieves dropped the torch and ran away as quickly as they could.
L119-D08.translation: 小偷扔下手电筒，拼命跑掉了。
L119-D08.speaker: man

L119-D09.text: George heard the noise and came downstairs quickly.
L119-D09.translation: 乔治听到响声，迅速下楼。
L119-D09.speaker: man

L119-D10.text: He turned on the light, but he couldn't see anyone.
L119-D10.translation: 他打开灯，却没看到任何人。
L119-D10.speaker: man

L119-D12.text: But George's parrot, Henry, was still there.
L119-D12.translation: 但乔治的鹦鹉亨利还在那里。
L119-D12.speaker: man

L119-D14.text: 'Nothing, Henry,' George said and smiled. 'Go back to sleep.'
L119-D14.translation: 乔治笑着说：“没什么，亨利。继续睡吧。”
L119-D14.speaker: man

L119-N-GRAMMAR.text: had + 过去分词表示某个过去时刻之前已经发生。after ... had done 是先完成再发生，before 则从另一方向交代先后。辨别谁说话要综合结尾线索。

L119-E01.text: The train had already left when I arrived.
L119-E01.translation: 我到时火车已经开走了。

L119-E02.text: She went home after she had finished work.

L119-E03.text: He had done his homework before he went to bed.
L119-E03.translation: 他睡觉前已经做完作业。

L119-E04.text: They had sold the car before I asked the price.
L119-E04.translation: 我问价格前，他们已经卖掉了车。

L119-E05.text: We had had dinner before they arrived.
L119-E05.translation: 他们到之前我们已经吃过晚饭。

L119-E06.text: She read the book after she had seen the film.
L119-E06.translation: 她看过电影后读了那本书。

L119-N-LINE01.text: 你喜欢故事吗？我想给你讲个真实的故事。

L119-N-LINE02.text: 这发生在我的一位朋友身上，是一年前的事。

L119-N-LINE03.text: 我朋友乔治在床上读书时，两个小偷爬进了他的厨房。

L119-N-LINE04.text: 他们进屋后，来到了餐厅。

L119-N-LINE05.text: 里面很黑，所以他们打开手电筒。

L119-N-LINE06.text: 突然，他们听见身后有声音。

L119-N-LINE08.text: 小偷扔下手电筒，拼命跑掉了。

L119-N-LINE09.text: 乔治听到响声，迅速下楼。

L119-N-LINE10.text: 他打开灯，却没看到任何人。

L119-N-LINE12.text: 但乔治的鹦鹉亨利还在那里。

L119-N-LINE14.text: 乔治笑着说：“没什么，亨利。继续睡吧。”

L121-D01.text: I bought two expensive dictionaries here half an hour ago, but I forgot to take them with me.
L121-D01.translation: 半小时前我在这里买了两本很贵的词典，但忘了带走。
L121-D01.speaker: man

L121-D03.text: The lady who is standing behind the counter.
L121-D03.translation: 站在柜台后面的那位女士。
L121-D03.speaker: man

L121-D05.text: The books which are on the counter.
L121-D05.speaker: man

L121-D06.text: Did you serve this gentleman half an hour ago, Caroline? He says he's the man who bought these books.
L121-D06.translation: 卡罗琳，你半小时前接待过这位先生吗？他说这些书是他买的。
L121-D06.speaker: man

L121-D07.text: I can't remember. The man who I served was wearing a hat.
L121-D07.translation: 我不记得了。我接待的那个人戴着帽子。
L121-D07.speaker: woman

L121-D08.text: Have you got a hat, sir?
L121-D08.speaker: man

L121-D10.text: Would you put it on, please?
L121-D10.speaker: man

L121-D12.text: Is this the man that you served, Caroline?
L121-D12.translation: 卡罗琳，这是你接待的那个人吗？
L121-D12.speaker: man

L121-N-GRAMMAR.text: who/that 可指人，which/that 可指物；从句紧跟要说明的名词。关系词作主语不能随意省略，作宾语常可省略。

L121-E01.text: She is the woman who served me.
L121-E01.translation: 她就是接待我的那位女士。

L121-E02.text: This is the book which I bought yesterday.

L121-E03.text: The man who is standing there is my teacher.
L121-E03.translation: 站在那里的男人是我的老师。

L121-E04.text: He is the man who came here last week.
L121-E04.translation: 他就是上周来这里的那个人。

L121-E05.text: This is the car which broke down.

L121-E06.text: These are the things which I bought.

L121-N-LINE01.text: 半小时前我在这里买了两本很贵的词典，但忘了带走。

L121-N-LINE03.text: 站在柜台后面的那位女士。

L121-N-LINE06.text: 卡罗琳，你半小时前接待过这位先生吗？他说这些书是他买的。

L121-N-LINE07.text: 我不记得了。我接待的那个人戴着帽子。

L121-N-LINE12.text: 卡罗琳，这是你接待的那个人吗？

L123-D01.text: Look, Scott. This is a photograph I took during my trip to Australia.
L123-D01.translation: 看，斯科特。这是我去澳大利亚旅行时拍的照片。
L123-D01.speaker: man

L123-D03.text: This is a good photograph. Who are these people?
L123-D03.speaker: man

L123-D04.text: They're people I met during the trip.
L123-D04.translation: 他们是我在旅途中认识的人。
L123-D04.speaker: man

L123-D05.text: That's the ship we travelled on.
L123-D05.speaker: man

L123-D08.text: That's the man I told you about. Remember?
L123-D08.translation: 那就是我告诉过你的那个人，记得吗？
L123-D08.speaker: man

L123-D09.text: Ah yes. The one who offered you a job in Australia.
L123-D09.translation: 噢，对。给你提供澳大利亚工作的那个人。
L123-D09.speaker: man

L123-D15.text: I grew a beard during the trip, but I shaved it off when I came home.
L123-D15.translation: 旅行时我留了胡子，但回家后刮掉了。
L123-D15.speaker: man

L123-D16.text: Why did you shave it off?
L123-D16.speaker: man

L123-N-GRAMMAR.text: 关系词作宾语时可省略：the photograph I took。介词不要漏：the ship we travelled on。主语关系词不可直接省略，但 who is standing 可以整体简化为 standing。

L123-E01.text: That is the ship we travelled on.

L123-E02.text: These are the people I met during the trip.
L123-E02.translation: 这些是我旅途中认识的人。

L123-E03.text: This is the photograph I took yesterday.

L123-E04.text: This is the book I told you about.
L123-E04.translation: 这就是我和你说过的那本书。

L123-E05.text: I grew a beard during the trip.

L123-E06.text: The woman standing there is my teacher.
L123-E06.translation: 站在那里的女士是我的老师。

L123-N-LINE01.text: 看，斯科特。这是我去澳大利亚旅行时拍的照片。

L123-N-LINE04.text: 他们是我在旅途中认识的人。

L123-N-LINE08.text: 那就是我告诉过你的那个人，记得吗？

L123-N-LINE09.text: 噢，对。给你提供澳大利亚工作的那个人。

L123-N-LINE15.text: 旅行时我留了胡子，但回家后刮掉了。

L125-D01.text: Can't you come in and have tea now, Peter?
L125-D01.translation: 彼得，你现在不能进来喝茶吗？
L125-D01.speaker: woman

L125-D02.text: Not yet. I must water the garden first.
L125-D02.translation: 还不行，我必须先给花园浇水。
L125-D02.speaker: man

L125-D03.text: Do you have to water it now?
L125-D03.speaker: woman

L125-D04.text: I'm afraid I must. Look at it! It's terribly dry.
L125-D04.translation: 恐怕是的。看看花园，太干了。
L125-D04.speaker: man

L125-D06.text: Last summer it was very dry, too. Don't you remember? I had to water it every day.
L125-D06.translation: 去年夏天也很干，你不记得了吗？我每天都得浇水。
L125-D06.speaker: man

L125-D07.text: Well, I'll have tea by myself.
L125-D07.speaker: woman

L125-D08.text: That was quick! Have you finished already?
L125-D08.speaker: woman

L125-D09.text: Yes. Look out of the window.
L125-D09.speaker: man

L125-D10.text: It's raining! That means you don't need to water the garden.
L125-D10.translation: 下雨了！那就是说你不必给花园浇水了。
L125-D10.speaker: woman

L125-D11.text: That was a pleasant surprise. It means I can have tea, instead.
L125-D11.translation: 真是个惊喜。这表示我可以来喝茶了。
L125-D11.speaker: man

L125-N-GRAMMAR.text: have to 表示不得不；过去用 had to，将来用 will have to。don’t need to / don’t have to 表示没必要，不等于 mustn’t 的禁止。by myself 表示独自。

L125-E01.text: You do not need to water the garden.

L125-E03.text: I had to take a taxi yesterday.
L125-E03.translation: 我昨天不得不乘出租车。

L125-E04.text: We will have to get up early tomorrow.
L125-E04.translation: 我们明天将不得不早起。

L125-E05.text: Do you have to leave now?

L125-E06.text: I will have tea by myself.

L125-N-LINE01.text: 彼得，你现在不能进来喝茶吗？

L125-N-LINE02.text: 还不行，我必须先给花园浇水。

L125-N-LINE04.text: 恐怕是的。看看花园，太干了。

L125-N-LINE06.text: 去年夏天也很干，你不记得了吗？我每天都得浇水。

L125-N-LINE10.text: 下雨了！那就是说你不必给花园浇水了。

L125-N-LINE11.text: 真是个惊喜。这表示我可以来喝茶了。

L127-D01.text: Can you recognize that woman, Liz?
L127-D01.translation: 莉兹，你认得那个女人吗？
L127-D01.speaker: woman

L127-D02.text: I think I can, Kate. It must be Karen Marsh, the actress.
L127-D02.translation: 凯特，我想认得。她准是女演员卡伦·马什。
L127-D02.speaker: woman

L127-D03.text: I thought so. Who's that beside her?
L127-D03.translation: 我也这样想。她旁边那个人是谁？
L127-D03.speaker: woman

L127-D05.text: Conrad Reeves, the actor? It can't be. Let me have another look.
L127-D05.translation: 男演员康拉德·里夫斯？不可能，让我再看看。
L127-D05.speaker: woman

L127-D06.text: I think you're right! Isn't he her third husband?
L127-D06.translation: 我想你说得对！他不是她的第三任丈夫吗？
L127-D06.speaker: woman

L127-D07.text: No. He must be her fourth or fifth.
L127-D07.translation: 不是，他肯定是她的第四任或第五任。
L127-D07.speaker: woman

L127-D08.translation: 卡伦·马什看起来真老啊！
L127-D08.speaker: woman

L127-D09.text: She does, doesn't she! I read she's twenty-nine, but she must be at least forty.
L127-D09.translation: 是啊！我读到她二十九岁，但她准有至少四十岁。
L127-D09.speaker: woman

L127-D11.text: She was a famous actress when I was still at school.
L127-D11.translation: 我还在上学时，她就已经是著名女演员了。
L127-D11.speaker: woman

L127-D12.text: That was a long time ago, wasn't it?
L127-D12.speaker: woman

L127-D13.text: Not that long ago! I'm not more than twenty-nine myself.
L127-D13.translation: 没那么久！我自己还不超过二十九岁呢。
L127-D13.speaker: woman

L127-N-GRAMMAR.text: must be 在此表示推测“一定是”，can’t be 表示“不可能是”。人物关于身份和年龄的猜测不等于已证实事实。

L127-E01.text: His bag is here. He must be nearby.
L127-E01.translation: 他的包在这里，他一定在附近。

L127-E02.text: This cannot be my key. Mine is blue.
L127-E02.translation: 这不可能是我的钥匙，我的是蓝色的。

L127-E04.text: It cannot be Monday. Today is Tuesday.
L127-E04.translation: 不可能是星期一，今天是星期二。

L127-E05.text: He must be at least forty.

L127-N-LINE01.text: 莉兹，你认得那个女人吗？

L127-N-LINE02.text: 凯特，我想认得。她准是女演员卡伦·马什。

L127-N-LINE03.text: 我也这样想。她旁边那个人是谁？

L127-N-LINE05.text: 男演员康拉德·里夫斯？不可能，让我再看看。

L127-N-LINE06.text: 我想你说得对！他不是她的第三任丈夫吗？

L127-N-LINE07.text: 不是，他肯定是她的第四任或第五任。

L127-N-LINE08.text: 卡伦·马什看起来真老啊！

L127-N-LINE09.text: 是啊！我读到她二十九岁，但她准有至少四十岁。

L127-N-LINE11.text: 我还在上学时，她就已经是著名女演员了。

L127-N-LINE13.text: 没那么久！我自己还不超过二十九岁呢。

L129-D01.text: Look, Gary! That policeman's waving to you. He wants you to stop.
L129-D01.translation: 看，加里！那位警察在向你挥手，他要你停车。
L129-D01.speaker: woman

L129-D02.text: Where do you think you are? On a race track?
L129-D02.translation: 你以为这是哪里？赛车道吗？
L129-D02.speaker: man

L129-D03.text: You must have been driving at seventy miles an hour.
L129-D03.translation: 你刚才一定开到了每小时七十英里。
L129-D03.speaker: man

L129-D05.text: I was doing eighty when I overtook you.
L129-D05.translation: 我超过你时，时速是八十英里。
L129-D05.speaker: man

L129-D06.text: Didn't you see the speed limit?
L129-D06.speaker: man

L129-D07.text: I'm afraid I didn't, officer. I must have been dreaming.
L129-D07.translation: 警官，恐怕没看见。我当时一定在走神。
L129-D07.speaker: man

L129-D08.text: He wasn't dreaming, officer. I was telling him to drive slowly.
L129-D08.translation: 警官，他不是在做梦，我当时正告诉他慢点开。
L129-D08.speaker: woman

L129-D09.text: That's why I didn't see the sign.
L129-D09.translation: 这就是我没看到标志的原因。
L129-D09.speaker: man

L129-D10.text: Let me see your driving licence.
L129-D10.translation: 让我看看你的驾驶执照。
L129-D10.speaker: man

L129-D11.text: I won't charge you this time. But you'd better not do it again!
L129-D11.translation: 这次我不处罚你，但你最好别再这样！
L129-D11.speaker: man

L129-D12.text: Thank you. I'll certainly be more careful.
L129-D12.speaker: man

L129-D13.text: I told you to drive slowly, Gary.
L129-D13.translation: 加里，我告诉过你慢点开。
L129-D13.speaker: woman

L129-D14.text: You always tell me to drive slowly, darling.
L129-D14.translation: 亲爱的，你总叫我慢点开。
L129-D14.speaker: man

L129-D15.text: Well, next time you'd better take my advice!
L129-D15.translation: 那下次你最好听我的建议！
L129-D15.speaker: woman

L129-N-GRAMMAR.text: must have been 是对过去的推测；had to 表示过去不得不做，含义不同。can’t have been 表示推断过去不可能。had better not + 原形表示最好不要。

L129-E01.text: He did not hear the phone. He must have been sleeping.
L129-E01.translation: 他没听到电话，他当时一定在睡觉。

L129-E02.text: I lost my key, so I had to wait.
L129-E02.translation: 我丢了钥匙，所以不得不等待。

L129-E03.text: She cannot have been at home yesterday.

L129-E04.text: You had better not drive so quickly.

L129-E05.text: They must have been tired after the trip.

L129-E06.text: He forgot his case, so he had to return home.
L129-E06.translation: 他忘了箱子，所以不得不回家。

L129-N-LINE01.text: 看，加里！那位警察在向你挥手，他要你停车。

L129-N-LINE02.text: 你以为这是哪里？赛车道吗？

L129-N-LINE03.text: 你刚才一定开到了每小时七十英里。

L129-N-LINE05.text: 我超过你时，时速是八十英里。

L129-N-LINE07.text: 警官，恐怕没看见。我当时一定在走神。

L129-N-LINE08.text: 警官，他不是在做梦，我当时正告诉他慢点开。

L129-N-LINE09.text: 这就是我没看到标志的原因。

L129-N-LINE10.text: 让我看看你的驾驶执照。

L129-N-LINE11.text: 这次我不处罚你，但你最好别再这样！

L129-N-LINE13.text: 加里，我告诉过你慢点开。

L129-N-LINE14.text: 亲爱的，你总叫我慢点开。

L129-N-LINE15.text: 那下次你最好听我的建议！

L131-D01.text: Where are you going to spend your holidays this year, Gary?
L131-D01.translation: 加里，你今年准备到哪里度假？
L131-D01.speaker: man

L131-D02.text: We may go abroad. I'm not sure. My wife wants to go to Egypt. I'd like to go there, too. We can't make up our minds.
L131-D02.translation: 我们可能出国，还不确定。我妻子想去埃及，我也想去，我们还拿不定主意。
L131-D02.speaker: man

L131-D03.text: Will you travel by sea or by air?
L131-D03.speaker: man

L131-D06.text: It may be cheaper, but it takes a long time.
L131-D06.translation: 可能更便宜，但花的时间长。
L131-D06.speaker: man

L131-D07.translation: 我相信你们会玩得开心。
L131-D07.speaker: man

L131-D08.text: Don't be so sure. We might not go anywhere.
L131-D08.translation: 别那么肯定，我们也许哪儿都不去。
L131-D08.speaker: man

L131-D09.text: My wife always worries too much. Who's going to look after the dog? Who's going to look after the house? Who's going to look after the garden?
L131-D09.translation: 我妻子总担心得太多。谁照看狗？谁照看房子？谁照看花园？
L131-D09.speaker: man

L131-D10.text: We have this problem every year. In the end, we stay at home and look after everything!
L131-D10.translation: 每年我们都有这个问题，最后就留在家里照看一切！
L131-D10.speaker: man

L133-D04.translation: 不，我不打算拍了。我准备退休，觉得很累，很长一段时间内都不想再拍电影。

L133-D06.translation: “卡伦·马什：轰动新闻！本报记者艾伦·琼斯报道。
L133-D06.speaker: woman

L133-D07.text: Karen Marsh arrived at London Airport today.
L133-D07.translation: 卡伦·马什今天抵达伦敦机场。
L133-D07.speaker: woman

L133-D08.text: She was wearing a blue dress and a mink coat.
L133-D08.translation: 她穿着蓝色连衣裙和貂皮大衣。
L133-D08.speaker: woman

L133-D09.text: She told me she had just made a new film.
L133-D09.translation: 她告诉我她刚拍了一部新电影。
L133-D09.speaker: woman

L133-D10.text: She said she was not going to make another. She said she was going to retire.
L133-D10.translation: 她说她不打算再拍一部，说她准备退休。

L133-D11.text: She told reporters she felt very tired and didn't want to make another film for a long time.'

L135-D01.text: Are you really going to retire, Miss Marsh?
L135-D01.translation: 马什小姐，您真的准备退休吗？
L135-D01.speaker: man

L135-D02.text: I may. I can't make up my mind. I will have to ask my future husband. He won't let me make another film.
L135-D02.translation: 可能吧。我拿不定主意，得问问我未来的丈夫。他不会让我再拍电影。
L135-D02.speaker: woman

L135-D03.translation: 马什小姐，您未来的丈夫？

L135-D04.text: Yes. Let me introduce him to you. His name is Carlos. We're going to get married next week.
L135-D04.translation: 是的，让我介绍给您。他叫卡洛斯，我们准备下周结婚。
L135-D04.speaker: woman

L135-D05.text: Look, Liz! Here's another report about Karen Marsh. Listen: 'Karen Marsh: The latest.

L135-D08.speaker: woman

L135-D09.text: She said her future husband would not let her make another film.
L135-D09.translation: 她说她未来的丈夫不会让她再拍电影。
L135-D09.speaker: woman

L135-D10.text: Then she introduced us to Carlos and told us they would get married next week.'
L135-D10.translation: 接着她把卡洛斯介绍给我们，并告诉我们他们下周会结婚。”

L137-D01.text: Are you doing the football pools, Brian?
L137-D01.translation: 布赖恩，你在下足球赛赌注吗？
L137-D01.speaker: woman

L137-D02.text: Yes, I've nearly finished, Julie. I'm sure we'll win something this week.
L137-D02.translation: 是的，朱莉，我快填好了。我相信这周我们会赢些钱。
L137-D02.speaker: man

L137-D03.text: You always say that, but we never win anything! What will you do if you win a lot of money?
L137-D03.translation: 你总这样说，但我们从来没赢过！如果赢了很多钱，你会做什么？
L137-D03.speaker: woman

L137-D04.text: If I win a lot of money I'll buy you a mink coat.
L137-D04.translation: 如果赢了很多钱，我会给你买件貂皮大衣。
L137-D04.speaker: man

L137-D05.text: I don't want a mink coat! I want to see the world.
L137-D05.translation: 我不要貂皮大衣！我想看看世界。
L137-D05.speaker: woman

L137-D06.text: All right. If we win a lot of money we'll travel round the world and we'll stay at the best hotels.
L137-D06.translation: 好吧，如果赢了很多钱，我们就环游世界，住最好的酒店。
L137-D06.speaker: man

L137-D07.text: Then we'll return home and buy a big house in the country. We'll have a beautiful garden and ...
L137-D07.translation: 然后回家，在乡下买所大房子，会有漂亮的花园，还有……
L137-D07.speaker: man

L137-D08.text: But if we spend all that money we'll be poor again. What'll we do then?
L137-D08.translation: 但如果把钱花光，我们又会变穷，那时怎么办？
L137-D08.speaker: woman

L137-D09.text: If we spend all the money we'll try and win the football pools again.
L137-D09.translation: 如果花光了，我们再试着赢足球彩票。
L137-D09.speaker: man

L137-D10.text: It's a pleasant dream but everything depends on 'if'!
L137-D10.translation: 这是个美梦，但一切都取决于“如果”！
L137-D10.speaker: woman

L137-N-GRAMMAR.text: 真实条件句中 if 从句用一般现在时表达未来条件，主句常用 will/can + 原形。if 强调尚未实现的条件。

L137-E01.text: If it rains tomorrow, we will stay at home.
L137-E01.translation: 如果明天下雨，我们就待在家里。

L137-E02.text: If he misses the bus, he will take a taxi.
L137-E02.translation: 如果他错过公共汽车，就会乘出租车。

L137-E03.text: We will miss the train if we do not hurry.
L137-E03.translation: 如果不快点，我们就会错过火车。

L137-E04.text: If they come home early, they can play in the garden.
L137-E04.translation: 如果他们早回家，就可以在花园玩。

L137-E05.text: If you ask me, I will tell you the truth.
L137-E05.translation: 如果你问我，我会告诉你真相。

L137-N-LINE02.text: 是的，朱莉，我快填好了。我相信这周我们会赢些钱。

L137-N-LINE03.text: 你总这样说，但我们从来没赢过！如果赢了很多钱，你会做什么？

L137-N-LINE04.text: 如果赢了很多钱，我会给你买件貂皮大衣。

L137-N-LINE05.text: 我不要貂皮大衣！我想看看世界。

L137-N-LINE06.text: 好吧，如果赢了很多钱，我们就环游世界，住最好的酒店。

L137-N-LINE09.text: 如果花光了，我们再试着赢足球彩票。

L137-N-LINE10.text: 这是个美梦，但一切都取决于“如果”！

L139-D03.text: Tell Mary we'll be late for dinner this evening.
L139-D03.translation: 告诉玛丽我们今晚吃饭要迟到。
L139-D03.speaker: man

L139-D05.text: Hasn't Mary told you? She invited Charlotte and me to dinner this evening.
L139-D05.translation: 玛丽没告诉你吗？她邀请夏洛特和我今晚吃饭。
L139-D05.speaker: man

L139-D06.text: I said I would be at your house at six o'clock, but the boss wants me to do some extra work.
L139-D06.translation: 我说过六点到你家，但老板让我额外做些工作。
L139-D06.speaker: man

L139-D07.text: I'll have to stay at the office. I don't know when I'll finish.
L139-D07.translation: 我得留在办公室，不知道什么时候做完。
L139-D07.speaker: man

L139-D08.text: Oh, and by the way, my wife wants to know if Mary needs any help.
L139-D08.translation: 噢，顺便说一句，我妻子想知道玛丽是否需要帮助。
L139-D08.speaker: man

L139-D09.text: I don't know what you're talking about.
L139-D09.speaker: man

L139-D10.text: That is John Smith, isn't it?
L139-D10.speaker: man

L139-D12.text: You are John Smith, the engineer, aren't you?
L139-D12.translation: 你是工程师约翰·史密斯，对吧？
L139-D12.speaker: man

L139-D14.text: You work for the Overseas Engineering Company, don't you?
L139-D14.translation: 你在海外工程公司工作，对吧？
L139-D14.speaker: man

L139-D15.text: No, I don't. I'm John Smith the telephone engineer and I'm repairing your telephone line.
L139-D15.translation: 不，我不是。我是电话工程师约翰·史密斯，正在修你的电话线。
L139-D15.speaker: man

L141-D01.text: Last week, my four-year-old daughter, Sally, was invited to a children's party.
L141-D01.translation: 上周，我四岁的女儿萨莉被邀请参加一个儿童聚会。
L141-D01.speaker: man

L141-D02.text: I decided to take her by train.
L141-D02.speaker: man

L141-D03.text: Sally was very excited because she had never travelled on a train before.
L141-D03.translation: 萨莉很兴奋，因为她以前从没坐过火车。
L141-D03.speaker: man

L141-D04.text: She sat near the window and asked questions about everything she saw.
L141-D04.translation: 她坐在窗边，对看到的一切不停提问。
L141-D04.speaker: man

L141-D05.text: Suddenly, a middle-aged lady got on the train and sat opposite Sally.
L141-D05.translation: 突然，一位中年女士上车，坐在萨莉对面。
L141-D05.speaker: man

L141-D07.text: Sally did not answer, but looked at her curiously.
L141-D07.translation: 萨莉没回答，只是好奇地看着她。
L141-D07.speaker: man

L141-D08.text: The lady was dressed in a blue coat and a large, funny hat.
L141-D08.translation: 那女士穿蓝色外套，戴着一顶大而有趣的帽子。
L141-D08.speaker: man

L141-D09.text: After the train had left the station, the lady opened her handbag and took out her powder compact.
L141-D09.translation: 火车驶离车站后，女士打开手提包，拿出粉盒。
L141-D09.speaker: man

L141-D10.text: She then began to make up her face.
L141-D10.speaker: man

L141-D11.text: 'Why are you doing that?' Sally asked.
L141-D11.translation: 萨莉问：“你为什么这样做？”
L141-D11.speaker: man

L141-D12.text: 'To make myself beautiful,' the lady answered.
L141-D12.translation: 女士回答：“让自己变漂亮。”
L141-D12.speaker: man

L141-D13.text: She put away her compact and smiled kindly.
L141-D13.translation: 她收起粉盒，和善地笑了。
L141-D13.speaker: man

L141-D14.text: 'But you are still ugly,' Sally said.
L141-D14.translation: 萨莉说：“但你还是难看呀。”
L141-D14.speaker: man

L141-D15.text: Sally was amused, but I was very embarrassed!
L141-D15.translation: 萨莉觉得有趣，我却非常尴尬！
L141-D15.speaker: man

L141-N-GRAMMAR.text: 被动语态 be + 过去分词，把动作接受者放前面；现在 is/are done，过去 was/were done。故事里的外貌评论让妈妈感到尴尬。

L141-E03.text: These flowers are watered every day.
L141-E03.translation: 这些花每天都有人浇水。

L141-E05.text: They were met at the station this morning.
L141-E05.translation: 今天早上有人在车站接他们。

L143-D01.text: I live in a very old town which is surrounded by beautiful woods.
L143-D01.translation: 我住在一个很古老的小镇，四周是美丽的树林。
L143-D01.speaker: man

L143-D02.text: It is a famous beauty spot.
L143-D02.speaker: man

L143-D03.text: On Sundays, hundreds of people come from the city to see our town and to walk through the woods.
L143-D03.translation: 每逢星期日，数百人从城市来参观小镇，在林间散步。
L143-D03.speaker: man

L143-D04.text: Visitors have been asked to keep the woods clean and tidy.
L143-D04.translation: 游客们被要求保持树林干净整洁。
L143-D04.speaker: man

L143-D05.text: Litter baskets have been placed under the trees, but people still throw their rubbish everywhere.
L143-D05.translation: 树下已经放了垃圾筐，但人们还是到处扔垃圾。
L143-D05.speaker: man

L143-D06.text: Last Wednesday, I went for a walk in the woods.
L143-D06.speaker: man

L143-D07.text: What I saw made me very sad.
L143-D07.translation: 所见的景象让我很难过。
L143-D07.speaker: man

L143-D08.text: I counted seven old cars and three old refrigerators.
L143-D08.translation: 我数到了七辆旧汽车和三个旧冰箱。
L143-D08.speaker: man

L143-D09.text: The litter baskets were empty and the ground was covered with pieces of paper, cigarette ends, old tyres, empty bottles and rusty tins.
L143-D09.translation: 垃圾筐是空的，地上却满是纸片、烟头、旧轮胎、空瓶子和生锈的罐头盒。
L143-D09.speaker: man

L143-D10.text: Among the rubbish, I found a sign which said, 'Anyone who leaves litter in these woods will be prosecuted!'
L143-D10.translation: 在垃圾中，我找到一块牌子，上面写着：“凡在林中丢弃垃圾者将被起诉！”
L143-D10.speaker: man

L143-N-GRAMMAR.text: 完成被动为 have/has been + 过去分词；将来被动为 will be + 过去分词。故事中的牌子讽刺“有告示却到处是垃圾”。最终综合关会跨章节复习。

L143-E01.text: The car has already been repaired.

L143-E02.text: The windows will be opened tomorrow.

L143-E03.text: These books have already been bought.

L143-E04.text: The room has not been cleaned yet.

L143-E05.text: The flowers will be watered soon.
L143-E05.translation: 这些花很快就会有人浇水。

L143-E06.text: Visitors have been asked to keep the woods tidy.
L143-E06.translation: 游客已被要求保持树林整洁。

L143-N-LINE01.text: 我住在一个很古老的小镇，四周是美丽的树林。

L143-N-LINE03.text: 每逢星期日，数百人从城市来参观小镇，在林间散步。

L143-N-LINE04.text: 游客们被要求保持树林干净整洁。

L143-N-LINE05.text: 树下已经放了垃圾筐，但人们还是到处扔垃圾。

L143-N-LINE07.text: 所见的景象让我很难过。

L143-N-LINE08.text: 我数到了七辆旧汽车和三个旧冰箱。

L143-N-LINE09.text: 垃圾筐是空的，地上却满是纸片、烟头、旧轮胎、空瓶子和生锈的罐头盒。

L143-N-LINE10.text: 在垃圾中，我找到一块牌子，上面写着：“凡在林中丢弃垃圾者将被起诉！”

chapters.title: 春天的巴黎下雨吗
